name: heineken-amsterdam
prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: finished scenery background for a portrait beer game theme, 1024 x 1536 pixels.
Style/medium: richly painted editorial travel postcard, soft gouache with fine colored-pencil detail, believable perspective and tactile materials. Nostalgic, lived-in moments with friends, quietly cinematic rather than a tourist landmark collage.
Composition: eye level of someone seated at a table. The foreground tabletop spans the FULL width of the image and fills exactly the bottom 32 percent, with its straight rear edge positioned precisely at 68 percent of image height. Keep the tabletop completely EMPTY across the central 70 percent. Reserve a calm, unobstructed central zone between x=30–70 percent and y=25–80 percent for a separate live game glass that will be composited later. Architecture, friends, and modest props must stay distant or near the outer edges. Anonymous friends should be small, peripheral figures, never a main portrait.
Constraints: scenery ONLY. Absolutely no foreground beer, no glass, cup, mug, bottle, can, or drink anywhere on the foreground table. No readable text, no logos, no signage lettering, no interface, borders, title, watermarks. Full bleed image. Do not draw the future glass.
Scene/backdrop: Amsterdam, canal-side café terrace on a warm golden afternoon. Red brick gabled canal houses on the opposite bank, bicycles leaning along a railing at the far left, reflected sunlight on quiet canal water, small friends chatting at a distant side table. Weathered oak foreground terrace table, warm red brick and greenish canal reflections. Soft amber light, settled holiday afternoon.
